title: The role of intestinal P-glycoprotein in the interaction of digoxin and rifampin
authors: Greiner B, Eichelbaum M, Fritz P, Kreichgauer HP, von Richter O, Zundler J, et al.
population: Healthy volunteers, each studied before and during rifampicin
funder: This work was supported by grants from the Robert Bosch Foundation and the Bundesministerium für Bildung, Wissenschaft, Forschung und Technologie (BMBF grant 01EC9405).
authorConflicts: Not stated. A footnote gives Merck KGaA as the present address of the first author.
result: Rifampicin 600 mg daily for 10 days reduced the peak plasma concentration of 1 mg oral digoxin by 58% and oral bioavailability by 30.1%, and raised duodenal P-glycoprotein content 3.5 ± 2.1-fold. Systemic clearance after 1 mg intravenous digoxin rose 21%; renal clearance and half-life were unchanged. A 2002 correction (J Clin Invest 110:571) revises the correlation between AUC 0 to 144 h and P-glycoprotein content to Spearman rs 0.71 (P < 0.005), gives oral bioavailability as 44% or 49.5% depending on the intravenous AUC used, and states that the principal findings stand.
